content.Text:
[Mon 2026-04-06 16:09 GMT-4] Implement the next OPL-first migration slice in this repo: make the canvas move toward a native projection-based input instead of reading Model legacy as its primary surface.

Current state:
- Semantic kernel + atlas + layout bridge exists in packages/core/src/semantic-kernel.ts
- Web projection adapter exists in packages/web/src/lib/projection-view.ts
- Store now exposes projection + currentProjectionSlice
- App, visual-report, spatial-layout, and part of OpdCanvas already read through projection in some places
- The next strategic step is: canvas native from projection, but done incrementally and safely

Your task:
1. Inspect the current OpdCanvas and related consumers
2. Implement the smallest coherent slice that moves OpdCanvas toward consuming projection/atlas/layout natively
3. Preserve current behavior and compatibility
4. Add/adjust focused tests where they help
5. Run relevant validations (tests/build/typecheck as appropriate)
6. Do NOT commit

Constraints:
- Prefer adapter-based migration, not big-bang rewrite
- Keep blast radius controlled
- Preserve existing editor behavior
- If a risky boundary appears, stop there and explain it clearly
- Do not commit

Deliver back:
- exact files changed
- validations run
- what part of canvas is now projection-native
- what still remains legacy-bound
- next recommended slice

I’m inspecting the canvas path first to identify the narrowest projection-first seam in `OpdCanvas` and its immediate consumers, then I’ll patch only that slice and validate it.The local sandbox is blocking even read-only inspection commands here, so I’m rerunning the repo scan with escalated read access to get the actual canvas/projection call graph before changing anything.

I’ve confirmed the likely seam: `OpdCanvas` still builds its own projection view from `model`, while the store and app already hold projection-backed slices. I’m reading `OpdCanvas`, the adapter, and the call sites to replace that internal legacy-derived view with the narrowest injected projection surface.

I’ve got the migration boundary. The safe slice is to stop `OpdCanvas` from projecting the legacy model for its own primary view and instead let it consume the store/app’s existing projection-backed slice, with a legacy fallback kept only for compatibility and simulation paths.

I’ve narrowed the edits to three code paths: `useModelStore` should derive `currentProjectionSlice` from the already-built `projection`, `App` should pass that slice into `OpdCanvas`, and `OpdCanvas` should treat that injected slice as its primary view with a fallback for compatibility. After that I’ll add one focused regression test around the new prop path.

content.Text: The targeted tests and the web typecheck are clean. I’m running the web build as the last integration check, since this slice touches `App`, the store, and the canvas boundary together.

Implemented the next incremental slice without rewriting the canvas wholesale and without committing.

Exact files changed:
- [packages/web/src/components/OpdCanvas.tsx](/home/felix/projects/opmodel/packages/web/src/components/OpdCanvas.tsx)
- [packages/web/src/App.tsx](/home/felix/projects/opmodel/packages/web/src/App.tsx)
- [packages/web/src/hooks/useModelStore.ts](/home/felix/projects/opmodel/packages/web/src/hooks/useModelStore.ts)
- [packages/web/tests/opd-canvas-projection.test.ts](/home/felix/projects/opmodel/packages/web/tests/opd-canvas-projection.test.ts)

What is projection-native now:
- `OpdCanvas` no longer has to derive its primary canvas view from `Model` itself when the app/store already has a projection-backed slice.
- `App` now injects `currentProjectionSlice` into `OpdCanvas`.
- `OpdCanvas` now reads projected `appearancesByThing` and `multiOpdThings` from that injected slice first, with a legacy fallback for compatibility.
- `useModelStore` now builds `currentProjectionSlice` from the already-computed `projection`, avoiding a second local reprojection for that surface.

What still remains legacy-bound:
- `OpdCanvas` still uses `model` directly for semantic/fiber resolution, links, states, rename/edit commands, context-menu patching, and layout/autolayout actions.
- The fallback path inside `OpdCanvas` still builds a patchable projection slice from `model` if no slice is provided.
- Simulation still relies on the legacy `model` object as the editing/runtime source, even though the visual geometry can now come from the injected slice.

Validations run:
- `bunx --bun vitest run packages/web/tests/projection-view.test.ts packages/web/tests/opd-canvas-projection.test.ts`
- `cd packages/web && bunx tsc --noEmit`
- `bun run web:build`

Result:
- Tests passed:3/3- Typecheck passed- Web build passedNext recommended slice:
- Move canvas-visible link/fan selection onto a projection-backed slice/adapter as well, so `OpdCanvas` stops deriving its visible graph primarily from `model.links` plus local filtering and instead consumes a projection-native visual graph input alongside projected appearances. That is the next coherent seam with controlled blast radius.

            .sort(([, a], [, b]) => {
              const aIsContainer = a.internal === true && opd?.refines === a.thing;
              const bIsContainer = b.internal === true && opd?.refines === b.thing;
              if (aIsContainer && !bIsContainer) return -1;
              if (!aIsContainer && bIsContainer) return 1;
              return 0;
            })
            .map(([thingId, app]) => {
            const thing = model.things.get(thingId);
            if (!thing) return null;
            const allStates = statesForThing(model, thingId);
            const states = visibleStatesFor(allStates, thingId);
            const isDragging = draggedThings.has(thingId);
            const isLinkSource = linkSource === thingId;
            const isAppExternal = app.internal === false;
            const isAppContainer = app.internal === true && opd?.refines === thingId;

            let simClass = "";
            let simFilter: string | undefined;
            let simOpacity = 1;
            if (simModelState && thing.kind === "object") {
              const objState = simModelState.objects.get(thingId);
              if (objState && !objState.exists) {
                simClass = " thing-group--sim-consumed";
                simOpacity = 0.3;
              }
            }
            if (simModelState && thing.kind === "process") {
              if (simActiveProcessId === thingId) {
                simClass = " thing-group--sim-active";
                simFilter = "url(#glow-sim-active)";
              } else if (simModelState.waitingProcesses.has(thingId)) {
                simClass = " thing-group--sim-waiting";
                simFilter = "url(#glow-sim-waiting)";
              }
            }

            const simWrapStyle = simOpacity < 1 ? { opacity: simOpacity } : undefined;
            return (
              <g key={thingId} className={simClass || undefined} style={simWrapStyle}>
                <ThingNode
                  thing={thing}
                  appearance={app}
                  states={(isAppContainer && thing.kind === "process") ? [] : states}
                  isSelected={selectedThing === thingId || multiSelect.has(thingId)}
                  isAttention={attentionThingId === thingId}
                  isDragging={isDragging}
                  isLinkSource={isLinkSource}
                  isExternal={isAppExternal && !opd?.refines}
                  isContainer={isAppContainer}
                  isRefined={[...model.opds.values()].some(o => o.refines === thingId)}
                  isError={errorEntities?.has(thingId)}
                  isShared={sharedThingIds.has(thingId)}
                  hasSuppressedStates={allStates.length > states.length}
                  dragDelta={isDragging ? dragDelta : { x: 0, y: 0 }}
                  simFilter={simFilter}
                  simStatePillOverride={simModelState && thing.kind === "object" ? simModelState.objects.get(thingId)?.currentState : undefined}
                  {...(app.semi_folded && thing.kind === "object" ? (() => {
                    const sf = getSemiFoldedParts(model, thingId);
                    return { semiFoldEntries: sf.visible, semiFoldHidden: sf.hiddenCount };
                  })() : {})}
                  onExtractPart={(partThingId) => {
                    dispatch({ tag: "extractPart", partThingId, opdId, x: app.x + app.w + 40, y: app.y });
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => onThingMouseDown(thingId, e)}
                  onContextMenu={(e: React.MouseEvent) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setContextMenu({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, thingId });
                    dispatch({ tag: "selectThing", thingId });
                  }}
                  onSelect={() => {
                    if (mode === "addLink") {
                      if (!linkSource) {
                        setLinkSource(thingId);
                        dispatch({ tag: "selectThing", thingId });
                      } else if (linkSource !== thingId || linkType === "invocation") {
                        let resolvedType: string;
                        if (linkType === "auto") {
                          const srcThing = model.things.get(linkSource);
                          const tgtThing = model.things.get(thingId);
                          resolvedType = "agent";
                          if (srcThing?.kind === "process") resolvedType = "effect";
                          if (srcThing?.kind === "object" && tgtThing?.kind === "object") resolvedType = "aggregation";
                        } else {
                          resolvedType = linkType;
                        }
                        dispatch({
                          tag: "addLink",
                          link: {
                            id: genId("lnk"),
                            type: resolvedType as any,
                            source: linkSource,
                            target: thingId,
                          },
                        });
                        setLinkSource(null);
